**Description of the correction:**

We identified a minor error in the post-processing script used to prepare Figure 4.
The error affected the mapping of Stan output parameters to the equations displayed in Figure 4, during the post-processing step used to express the relationships on the original trait scales.
As a result, the equations printed in the panels did not correspond to the properly back-transformed relationships for $VAF$ (%) and $K_s$ in the units shown on the axes.
We have replaced Figure 4 with a corrected version in which the displayed equations, fitted lines, and $R^2$ values are generated using the properly indexed model coefficients.
We have also made a minor update to the Figure 4 legend to clarify that Table S4 reports model-scale coefficients before back-transformation.
The correction has only a negligible visual effect on the fitted relationships.
This correction does not change the underlying model fits, statistical inference, biological interpretation, or conclusions of the study.
The main effect of this correction is to make the equations directly interpretable for readers using the trait units shown in the figure.

Sincerely,

Chen Ya-Jun and Ram Oren

/newpage

**Fig. 4**
Relationships between coefficients *a* and *b* and xylem anatomical traits.
Data are presented at the segment level (left two columns) and species level
(right two columns).
*VAF*, vessel lumen area fraction; *K~s~*, sapwood-specific hydraulic conductivity.
Points and error bars represent the posterior medians
and 95% credible intervals (CIs) of coefficients for each segment or species, respectively.
Shaded regions are 95% CIs.
Additional relationships between coefficients *a* and *b* and other xylem anatomical traits are provided in Supporting Information Fig. S10.
Details of statistical analyses for each trait, including model-scale coefficients before back-transformation, are shown in Table S4.
Note: Only 25 species are shown for the trait *VAF* due to missing values in the anatomy measurements.
